description: Change a Notebook entry. Only the fields you pass are touched, so an update that renames a note leaves its text, tags and filing standing.

claimId.description: Only holds when type is evidence.

content.description: Replaces the note's text and its blocks.

folder.description: Notebook folder name. Ignored when folderId is given.

folderId.description: Notebook folder id. Pass an empty folder name to unfile.

name: update_notebook_entry
